messages:
anna.k: Quick status check — pricing change rollout depends on a few infra pieces landing. TL;DR: metering adapter schema change, billing contract update, and quota enforcement flags. Who owns the final sign-off on the billing contract text?

benj: I can own the billing contract sign-off if legal + finance are OK with the wording. filing a checklist item now.

carlos-m: For the metering adapter schema: front-end SDK will need the new "unit_type" field. @lena_ops do we have backward-compat plan for older SDKs?

lena_ops: We do — runtime will accept missing unit_type and default to "token" for 30 days. Need to add a warning log and a feature flag: pricing.quota.strict_mode.

mike_billing: Important: quota enforcement has a contract constraint — customers on legacy contracts must stay on current quota rules until their renewal date. We need a mapping table. I'll share a sample export.

anna.k: Thanks. Action items: (1) benj to confirm legal/finance sign-off by EOD Monday, (2) carlos to open PR for adapter schema + SDK note, (3) lena to add feature flag + warning log, (4) mike to produce contract mapping CSV. Anyone want to adjust ownership?

benj: Confirmed I'll drive sign-off, pinging @legal and @finance now.

carlos-m: Opening draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 (WIP). Added schema diff in the description. Brief snippet:```json
{
  "name": "metering_adapter_v2",
  "fields": [
    {"name": "unit_type", "type": "string", "default": "token"},
    {"name": "units", "type": "int"}
  ]
}
```

lena_ops: For feature flag plan: I'll add pricing.quota.strict_mode default=false. Deploy window next Wed 03:00-05:00 UTC. Will also emit warning: "metering: unit_type missing, defaulting to token".

mike_billing: Attached mapping will include columns: customer_id, contract_type, renewal_ts, enforced_quota_version. Will drop in #support-drive and upload to GCS.

anna.k: Small blocker: the metering e2e harness fails on one test where legacy contract customers are double-billed in the sim. @mike_billing can you review the sim inputs?

mike_billing: On it, saw a suspicious row where renewal_ts was null. Likely import bug. I'll patch and re-run.

benj: Legal flagged one phrase: "retroactive adjustments" — we should reword to "service credits" per finance. I'll update submit.

carlos-m: PR updated with backwards compat tests and a migration plan doc. @anna.k can you review ownership in the runbook? added an ownership table.

anna.k: Reviewing now. Two small asks: add a rollback trigger to the runbook (high quota spike) and a smoke-check for billing totals after canary.

lena_ops: Will add smoke check: compare pre/post daily billing delta > 1.5x triggers rollback. Add to canary job: `scripts/smoke/billing_delta_check.sh`.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy:pricing-service:v2 started by lena_ops at 1769460000 — health checks pending.

mike_billing: Ran sim after import patch, looks clean. No double-billing in the test set.

benj: Legal + finance approved wording. Updated contract doc and pushed to drive.

anna.k: Great. Timeline check — aiming to complete canary and confirm metrics by tomorrow noon UTC. If all clear, target full rollout Thursday. Any objections?

carlos-m: No objections from infra side. Will be on call for canary.

lena_ops: I'll monitor canary and roll back if billing_delta_check fails.

mike_billing: I'll validate aggregates post-canary and sign off.

anna.k: Perfect. Final note — please add quick one-line updates to this thread as you hit each milestone so we have a single audit trail. :thumbsup:
